snippet.title: Meadowfell - Relax in a Cozy Open World for iOS & Android | Please Share❤️
snippet.description:
🌿 Meadowfell is here! Now available on iOS!
👉 Download on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/meadowfell/id6499377441
👉 Download on Google Play : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.protopop.meadowfell

Meadowfell is a cozy open-world game set in a cozy, peaceful countryside. There’s no combat, no quests - just a beautiful, serene world to explore at your own pace.

✨ What makes Meadowfell special?

🐎 Shapechange into animals and mythical creatures like dragons, horses, and trolls.
🏡 Find a home and design your own custom gardens.
🌍 Seamless Exploration: Wander a vast open world.
🌦️ Dynamic Environment: Experience a living world with natural sounds, changing skies, and vibrant ecosystems.
🎨 Endless Customization: Tweak time of day, weather, and dozens of other options to create your perfect experience.
🚫 No ads or in-app purchases: simply enjoy the full experience in a serene, open-world setting.


❤️ How you can support me as an indie dev:

1. Buy a copy of Meadowfell – your support helps me keep making games I love to share.
2. Share this trailer with someone who might enjoy it. Every share helps me reach more people.
3. Leave feedback! I’d love to hear what you think—your ideas help me improve the game and shape future updates.

I’m a solo developer, creating these worlds from the heart. Every dollar goes into food, rent, and making more creative, relaxing games like this. Thank you for being part of this journey. ❤️

🎮 What’s next?

I’ll be continuing to update Meadowfell with more features, customization options, and surprises. Stay tuned!

If you’re watching this on YouTube, please like, comment, and subscribe - it really helps more people discover Meadowfell.

#Meadowfell #IndieGame #CozyGames #OpenWorld #MobileGaming #Wilderless
